entries.reason: Owner-accepted non-blocking in the Phase 6A handoff (PACKAGING_QA = ACCEPTED_NON_BLOCKING); audience decision exists in owner-approval.json; persisted packaging-qa.json stays REVIEW_REQUIRED and is not forged to PASS

performanceReference.reason: Needs explicit per-reference rights/provenance capture and an ingestion path that does not exist yet; building it without them would risk unlicensed-reference use. Trigger: first owner request with a licensed reference.

representativePreview.reason: Short local segment preview + content-addressed cache already provided by bakeoff.getOrCreatePreview (<=35% of video, 1 render cap); no separate entity needed.

channelEditorialIdentity.reason: Identity enters the originality fingerprint (channelIdentityHash/editorialBibleVersion) so repeatable identity is recognised as intentional; richer authoring controls are deferred until a multi-episode channel exists.

note: Only owner-accepted P2/P3 subjective items can appear here; P0/P1 factual/rights/security/technical blockers are refused by construction.
